description: This file defines the LoanApplicationApprovalUndoCommandHandler class, which handles the undo approval command for loan applications within the Fineract project. It uses annotations to specify command type and transaction management, and delegates the undo operation to the LoanApplicationWritePlatformService.

classes.name: LoanApplicationApprovalUndoCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles undoing the approval of a loan application, integrating with the platform service and designated by specific command type annotations.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the undo approval command HTTP request, delegating to the write platform service to perform the undo operation on the specified loan application.
